errors.text_span: като височината на стълба е пропорционална на този дял
errors.evidence: The description uses the word "височината" (height) to describe the measure of the horizontal bars. The more accurate term for a horizontal bar chart is "дължината" (length).

errors.text_span: най-късият, за периода „1990–1995“, е малко над 16%
errors.evidence: The bar for the period "1990–1995" is the shortest, with a value of approximately 16%. Describing it as "малко над 16%" (a little over 16%) is an overestimation.
The bar for the period "2008-2012" clearly extends past the 20% mark to a value of approximately 21%. Describing it as "близо до 20%" (close to 20%) is an inaccurate understatement.
